# Water a houseplant

## Steps

1. Push a finger into the soil. Water only if the top two centimetres are dry.
2. Water slowly until it runs out of the drainage hole. Brighter rooms need this more often —
   see [bright rooms](../reference/houseplant-light-levels.md#bright-rooms).
3. Empty the saucer after ten minutes so the pot does not stand in water.
